"2d element merger game where you explore for elements in a small forest and collect tier 1 elements: water, fire, water, and air. And then you collect as many as possible so you can merge the tier 1 elements to get every possible combination of merged elements that are tier 2. You can't merge with other tiers. T2 plus t2 is t3, t3 plus t3 is t4, and t4 plus t4 is t5. (T equals tier). Make EVERY combination. Add bosses, online fighting, hp, weaknesses, strengths, and other stats. Add an index, title screen, ranks, leaderboards for different things, auras, titles, custom element maker, in-game currencies, gamemodes, shops, cheat codes, in-game levels to play with, a level maker, a tab for custom levels, level ranks, crafting, cool skins, a gamemode maker, a code screen for friends to play custom gamemodes and to play with custom elements, cool rng, power ups, and the BEST animations, graphics, and music/sfxs ever

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, polished, playable 2D element-merger forest game with exploration, merging, combat, progression, and extensive creator/social systems.

## Requirements
- Start with Water, Fire, Earth, and Air at Tier 1.
- Merge only elements from matching tiers:
  - T1 + T1 → T2
  - T2 + T2 → T3
  - T3 + T3 → T4
  - T4 + T4 → T5
- Include every generated merge combination within the gameplay system.
- Add bosses, HP, strengths/weaknesses, stats, index, title screen, ranks, leaderboards, currencies, crafting, shops, auras, titles, RNG, power-ups, levels, level maker, gamemode maker, custom elements, custom levels, code sharing, and cheat codes.
- Support desktop and mobile layouts.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a single-page offline HTML/CSS/JavaScript game in `index.html`.
- Used procedural emoji-based art and CSS graphics rather than external assets.
- Added local `localStorage` saving and daily reward tracking.
- Treated online room codes and leaderboards as local simulated features rather than real network multiplayer.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the welcome/title screen and persistent save state.
- Built the forest exploration, backpack, Tier 1 gathering, and currency/XP rewards.
- Built same-tier merging and automatic discovered-recipe generation.
- Built T1–T5 index and discovery journal.
- Built turn-based boss battles with HP, weaknesses, strengths, and rewards.
- Built shops, crafting, power-ups, ranks, leaderboards, achievements, titles, and auras.
- Built custom element creation, level maker, custom level play, gamemode maker, and friend room codes.
- Built cheat-code modal, mobile responsiveness, sound chimes, and animations.
- Fixed JavaScript syntax and corrected same-element merge inventory handling.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- Real live online fighting requires a backend/WebSocket service and is not implemented.
- Shared cross-device custom levels/gamemodes require server persistence and is not implemented.

## Next Move
1. Start a local server and verify the game in a browser.
2. Test the full merge flow and verify a T2, T3, T4, and T5 item can be created.
3. Test boss battles, custom element creation, level creation, saves, and mobile layout.
4. Capture and inspect a viewport screenshot for visual issues.
5. Add an explicit every-combination merge recipe model if deterministic T2/T3/T4/T5 names are required beyond generated pair names.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- The game is currently a single local app in `index.html`; no external build system or framework is required.
- State is automatically saved to `localStorage`, including inventory, discoveries, recipes, currencies, levels, custom elements, custom levels, and gamemodes.
- Room codes are generated locally and copied through the browser; friend play is simulated in this offline implementation.
- Cheat codes are local-only and implemented as `leafmealone`, `wildthings`, and `moonrise`.
- Syntax was checked successfully with `new Function(...)`.

## Objective
- Build and refine a playable element-merger forest game.
- Ensure merged Tier 2–5 elements appear in the discovered section of the index.

## Requirements
- Start with Water, Fire, Earth, and Air at Tier 1.
- Merge only elements of matching tiers: T1→T2, T2→T3, T3→T4, T4→T5.
- Give every merged element a custom name.
- Include exploration, combat, progression, creator/social features, and desktop/mobile layouts.

## Decisions
- Implement as a single-page offline game in `index.html`, with local save data.
- Use custom names for merge results; names are currently explicit for T2 and some T3 pairs, with themed fallback naming for higher tiers.
- Online rooms and leaderboards are simulated locally.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game’s core systems and creator features in `index.html`.
- Updated merge naming so results receive custom themed names instead of generic pair labels.
- Confirmed embedded JavaScript syntax passes validation.

### Active
- Make sure discovered merged elements from T2–T5 visibly appear in the Field Index’s discovered section.

### Blocked
- Real online multiplayer and cross-device sharing require backend services not present in the project.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `indexPage()` so discovered T2–T5 recipe results reliably render in their tier sections.
2. Test merging through T2, T3, T4, and T5, then confirm each result appears in the index.
3. Re-run JavaScript syntax validation.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Game implementation, merge recipes, discovery state, and Field Index rendering.

## Important Context
- `makeRecipe()` adds each result to `STATE.discovered`; `doMerge()` also adds it and saves state.
- `indexPage()` derives its displayed elements from `allElements()` filtered by `STATE.discovered`.
- The current `makeRecipe()` code includes an empty duplicate `3:{}` entry in its `tierNames` object; JavaScript syntax remains valid.
- Changes are uncommitted.
